status: Execution conventions selected before first Intel stock-value output. All earlier cash/operating forecasts and market price are known.
date_boundary: End2026 value uses the explicit opening2027 financial forecast. It is NOT a measured November3 fair value. Holding-period calculations compare November3 market entry with future2029/2030/2031 prices. Do not silently compound current equity at the operating discount rate.
annual_cash_timing: Year end. Terminal first cash is2041; valueat2040=FCFF2041/(r-g), g=.03.

new_capitalized_interest_tax_basis.first_deduction: Year following capitalization; equal eighths over eight years.
new_capitalized_interest_tax_basis.scope: An owned tax-timing normalization, not asserted MACRS class, bonus election or actual Intel statutory schedule. Excludes additional benefit from pre2027 capitalized-interest basis, already inside historical ordinary-tax normalization. Forward operating EBIT/D&A exclude amortization of NEW capitalized financing interest.
new_capitalized_interest_tax_basis.cash_benefit: ordinary operating cash tax rate times scheduled deductions, included once in treasury and in the separate financing-benefit PV. No immediate deduction of the whole capitalized amount.

post2030_debt_policy.ordinary_debt: Hold end2030 ordinary debt nominally constant through refinancing at par; no net new principal to finance operating growth. Access remains a forecast.
post2030_debt_policy.ordinary_interest: max(0,total_cash_coupon_rate*debt-1B), with any actual excess capitalization barred if total interest is less than1B.
post2030_debt_policy.source_limit: 5.2% is an owned rounded carrying-debt cash-cost normalization, not future quoted market yield or a complete maturity schedule.

financing_benefit_discount_judgment: Tax benefits depend on the forecast producing taxable income. Use the operating-risk rate rather than assume certain debt-like receipt. Discount-rate controls apply to both operating cash and these uncertain benefits.
financing_benefit_formula: Ordinary rate times ordinary debt cash interest plus scheduled new capitalized-interest deductions, capped by ordinary unlevered operating tax capacity. No cash-interest-income shield; cash-income taxes are in treasury.
cash_asset_rule: All unrestricted modeled economic cash is a separately owned financial asset valued at par. The20B floor constrains payouts/borrowing and is not a claim that the reserve has zero value or is immediately distributable. Interest income is excluded from operatingDCF and included only in the finite treasury path.
stock_and_claim_rules: Use5.51B economic planning claims from the financial policy, with full pending government escrow included once and dated cash receipts included once.
Retain economic SBC in operatingcash; no extra futuregrant dilution.
Use ordinary carrying debt with scheduled paydowns and disclosed market-value limitation; no second lease, escrow-derivative or NCI claim subtraction.
Net other assets5.717B is a nominal carrying proxy, not proof of marketvalue.
Classiq cash consideration reduces finite treasury; current reference also deducts its dated PV, with no separately credited acquisition franchise value.
reference2026_equity_formula: OperatingcashPV2027+ including dated existing/newcapitalcreditcollections and basis-loss charges + openingcash - openingordinarydebt +netotherassets +financingbenefitPV +PVgovernmentescrowcash -PVClassiqcash.
future_equity_formula: OperatingcashPVafterendpoint +futurefinancingbenefitPV +endpointcash -endpointordinarydebt +netotherassets; no duplication of priorcashreceipts, acquisitions or financialinterest.
audit_requirements: Recompute unlevered tax rather than retain the old after-interest tax.
Finite ownercash before newcredit/taxshield/financing events must reconcile to original proxy.
Debt principal and borrowing change cash/debt together.
Explicit tail matches direct extended cashsum.
No policy changes after output without a separate version and causal explanation.
